title: Uncapped desiredAPYBps converts directly into unbounded phUSD mint pressure; only friction is a 100-block (~20 min) two-step gate
rootCause: `setDesiredAPY` accepts any `uint256 bps`. `_updatePhUSDEmissionRate` computes `phUSDPerSecond = totalStaked * desiredAPYBps / 10000 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR` with no sanity cap. `_claimRewards` calls `phUSD.mint` against that rate. The only on-chain friction is the two-step preview/commit window (must commit within 100 blocks of the same value) — and SYMBOLIC-005 proves the gate state-machine is correctly implemented, so the gate provides exactly the protection it promises and nothing more.

symbolic.claim: Two-step gate state machine is correctly implemented (6/6 properties). This is a positive proof — it confirms the gate provides exactly the 100-block delay and nothing more (no implicit magnitude bound).

impactSummary: Owner unilaterally controls phUSD supply expansion via this contract with only a ~20-minute delay (much shorter on L2). Combined with phUSD being both the stake AND the reward, owner can pre-position a stake, hike APY, claim, and exit. Affects all phUSD holders system-wide, not just stakers.
preservedDetails: ECON-001 carries the strongest framing: cross-system phUSD inflation impact + MEV pre-stake monetisation + treatment of the 20-minute gate as effectively zero-friction. PATTERN-005 contributes the CENTRALIZATION-ADMIN pattern match and the structural 'unbounded-admin-parameter' framing.
remediation: Add `require(bps <= MAX_APY_BPS)` with MAX in the low thousands; replace block-based window with time-based (>= 24 hrs); wrap in on-chain timelock.
consolidationRationale: Both findings target the same setter on the same line. PATTERN-005 is the structural match; ECON-001 adds the cross-system phUSD inflation angle and the MEV pre-stake monetisation path. Single canonical, with PATTERN-005 framing folded in.
dedupNotes: SYMBOLIC-005 is preserved as positive-proof evidence: it confirms the gate works exactly as advertised, which is precisely why ECON-001's claim ('the gate is not a magnitude bound, just a delay') is valid.
